I would like to think of myself as a courageous person. I have bicycled 150 miles though the mountains in winter. I made a speech after HS graduation. I voluntarily lived in a Chevy van for a year. I've learned how to navigate social dance nights.

However, yesterday I had revelation. I am a fearful person. I am probably more anxiety ridden than many people on this planet. The reason I challenge myself is because deep down, I know I am scared. My body can't fool itself. My body is the very thing that is generating this feeling to begin with. I realize now that my fear stems from growing up with a single mother who was full of anxiety. Many adults have anxiety and my mother may not have it any more than those adults, but what my mother didn't have was an adult to give her emotional support. Instead the emotions were put on on myself and my brother. Her anxiety about finances and relationships transferred to me. She didn't understand the effect she had, but now she does. Although I do not agree with her decision to divorce my father, I am not angry with her for what that divorce has cause and I shared with her today my realization. Now that I have this self understanding that I am a fearful person, I know the enemy within and I can slay it.

So here is my question: what self revelations have you made lately?
